metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: branch-guard
plugins.description: Holds a git commit or git push on the protected branch and shows what would go in, with Proceed and Cancel.

plugins.name: chatgpt
plugins.description: Lets Claude ask your logged-in ChatGPT, or have it generate an image, through terminal-browser, and saves the result locally.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Routes native Mac app control through Codex computer use from the ChatGPT app, with per-app approval, one Codex session per Claude session or subagent, and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Makes the main session a lead that delegates to six specialist subagents: code-reader and research on Haiku; designer, developer and tester on Sonnet; architect on Opus. It also shows a live HUD of the crew's work (the session, the quota, the active plan's next steps, the running agents, the architect's verdicts and a log) in a side pane or a band above the prompt. With the jevKey option set (a TypeSafe key), Jev may move each call's model one step (the architect stays on Opus) and raise its effort to high; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai. With the nativeCodex option set and a local proxy as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, roles also get crew:<role>-codex subagent types that run on a Codex model through that proxy, which sends what those subagents read and write to OpenAI; with quotaRouting on, a call may move to its role's twin when Codex has more weekly headroom.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Lets Claude query and modify the tailnet through the Tailscale API, using TS_API_KEY.

plugins.name: codex-models
plugins.description: Offers OpenAI Codex models (ChatGPT login) in Claude Code through a local loopback proxy, in /model and in agent definitions, while Claude models pass through to Anthropic unchanged.
